user.description: Configure GitHub Copilot with a fine-grained token granting Copilot Requests, or connect to the GitHub Copilot Bridge add-on. Local mode downloads the matching CLI runtime if needed. See the [documentation]({documentation_url}).

data_description.api_token: Fine-grained GitHub token with Copilot Requests permission. Not needed with a bridge URL.
data_description.model: The AI model to use for conversations
data_description.cli_url: URL of the GitHub Copilot Bridge add-on server. Leave empty to run the CLI locally.
data_description.mcp_config: JSON containing mcpServers, or a JSON file path readable by Home Assistant. These servers and their selected tools are authorized to run without confirmation.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your GitHub token is valid and has Copilot permissions. Ensure you have an active GitHub Copilot subscription.
error.connection: Unable to connect to GitHub Copilot CLI. Please verify the Copilot CLI is installed and running (locally or via the add-on), and check the Copilot CLI URL if using the add-on.
error.invalid_url: Invalid URL. Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address for the Copilot Bridge add-on (for example, the add-on hostname on port 8000).
error.invalid_mcp: Provide valid mcpServers JSON or a readable Home Assistant JSON file. Check server types, URLs, headers, and tool lists.
error.token_required: GitHub Token is required when not using the Copilot Bridge add-on.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: GitHub Copilot is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

data_description.model: The AI model to use for conversations
data_description.cli_url: URL of the GitHub Copilot Bridge add-on server. Leave empty to run the CLI locally.
data_description.timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for a Copilot response before timing out. Increase this value for slower models (e.g. o1, o3-mini) or slower connections.
data_description.mcp_config: JSON containing mcpServers, or a JSON file path readable by Home Assistant. These servers and their selected tools are authorized to run without confirmation.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS bridge URL.
